translations.literal: all woven to completion.
translations.idiomatic: all woven to completion.

sentences.zh: 本色領褾襈裾。

translations.literal: Collar, cuffs, edging, and hem in the proper colors.
translations.idiomatic: The collar, cuffs, edging, and hem were in the proper colors.

sentences.zh: 纁裳四章，織藻、粉米、黼、黻各二，前三幅，後四幅，不相屬，共腰，有襞積，本色綼裼。

translations.literal: The deep-red skirt had four emblems, woven with waterweed, millet grain, axe-and-gouge, and opposed triangles, two each; three panels in front, four behind, not joined; sharing the waist; with a pleated fold; proper-color edging on the sides and hem.
translations.idiomatic: The deep-red skirt bore four emblems—waterweed, millet grain, axe-and-gouge, and opposed triangles, two of each—in three panels before and four behind, not joined front to back but sharing the waist, with a pleated fold and edging in the proper colors along the sides and hem.

sentences.zh: 中單以素紗為之，青領褾襈裾，領織黻文十一。

translations.literal: The inner robe was made of plain gauze, with a green collar, cuffs, edging, and hem; the collar was woven with eleven opposed-triangle motifs.
translations.idiomatic: The inner robe was plain gauze with a green collar, cuffs, edging, and hem, and eleven opposed-triangle motifs woven on the collar.

sentences.zh: 蔽膝隨裳色，四章，織藻、粉米、黼、黻。

translations.literal: The knee cover followed the skirt's color, four emblems, woven with waterweed, millet grain, axe-and-gouge, and opposed triangles.
translations.idiomatic: The knee cover matched the skirt in color and bore four emblems—waterweed, millet grain, axe-and-gouge, and opposed triangles.

sentences.zh: 本色緣，有紃，施於縫中。

translations.literal: Proper-color edging; there were cords set within the seams.
translations.idiomatic: It had edging in the proper colors and cords worked into the seams.

sentences.zh: 上玉鉤二。

translations.literal: Two jade hooks above.
translations.idiomatic: There were two jade hooks above.

sentences.zh: 玉佩二，各用玉珩一、瑀一、琚一、沖牙一、璜二；

translations.literal: Two jade pendants, each using one top bar, one secondary piece, one square plaque, one impact tooth, and two arc pieces;
translations.idiomatic: There were two jade pendants, each comprising one top bar, one secondary piece, one square plaque, one impact tooth, and two arc pieces;

sentences.zh: 瑀下垂玉花一、玉滴二。

translations.literal: from the secondary piece hung one jade blossom and two jade drops.
translations.idiomatic: from the secondary piece hung one jade blossom and two jade drops.

sentences.zh: 瑑雲龍文，描金。

translations.literal: Carved with cloud-and-dragon motifs and traced in gold.
translations.idiomatic: They were carved with cloud-and-dragon motifs and traced in gold.

sentences.zh: 自珩而下，系組五，貫以玉珠。

translations.literal: From the top bar downward five cords were attached, strung with jade beads.
translations.idiomatic: Below the top bar five cords were fastened, strung with jade beads.

sentences.zh: 上有金鉤。

translations.literal: There were gold hooks above.
translations.idiomatic: There were gold hooks above.

translations.idiomatic: There were small sashes in four colors

translations.literal: Collar, sleeve bands, cuff edging, and hem in the garment's natural color.

sentences.zh: 其纁裳、玉佩、帶、綬之制，俱與親王同，第領織黻文減二。

translations.literal: The deep-red skirt, jade pendants, belt, and sash all followed the same regulations as for a prince, except that the opposed-triangle motifs woven on the collar were reduced by two.

translations.idiomatic: The leather cap was covered with black gauze and had eight seams front and back; each seam carried eight tri-colored jade ornaments; everything else followed the prince's regulations.

sentences.zh: 其圭佩、帶綬、襪舄如冕服內制。

translations.literal: The jade tablet, pendants, belt, sash, stockings, and court shoes followed the inner specifications of the ceremonial robe.
translations.idiomatic: The jade tablet, pendants, belt, sash, stockings, and court shoes followed the inner specifications of the ceremonial robe.

sentences.zh: 常服亦與親王同。

translations.literal: Everyday dress was also the same as for a prince.
translations.idiomatic: Everyday dress was likewise the same as for a prince.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年定保和冠服，以燕弁為準，用八衤取，去簪玉，後山以一扇分畫為四，服與親王同。

translations.literal: In Jiajing 7 the Baohe court dress was established, modeled on the yan cap with eight panels, the hairpin jade removed, and the rear peak divided into four sections by a single fan-shaped partition; the dress itself matched that of a prince.

sentences.zh: 世子妃冠服：永樂三年定，與親王妃同，惟冠用七翟。

translations.idiomatic: The deep-red skirt had two emblem sections, with two axe-and-gouge and two opposed-triangle motifs woven on it.

sentences.zh: 中單，領織黻文七，餘與親王世子同。

translations.literal: Inner robe: seven opposed-triangle motifs woven on the collar; everything else followed the prince's heir.
translations.idiomatic: The inner robe bore seven opposed-triangle motifs woven on the collar; everything else matched the prince's heir.

sentences.zh: 郡王妃冠服：永樂三年定，冠用七翟，與親王世子妃同。

translations.idiomatic: The crown and dress of a commandery prince's consort: established in Yongle 3 (1405), the crown bore seven pheasant ornaments and otherwise matched those of a prince's heir consort.

translations.literal: The crown and dress of the commandery prince's eldest son's lady: pearl-and-kingfisher five-pheasant crown, great crimson silk-floss robe, deep blue silk-floss beizi embroidered in gold with pheasants, blue gauze cloud collar embroidered in gold with pheasants, gold pendant headpiece.
